facts.statement: The genus Yueosaurus was first named by Zheng et al. in 2012.
facts.quote: Yueosaurus was first named by Wenjie Zheng, Xingsheng Jin, Masateru Shibata, Yoichi Azuma and Fangming Yu in 2012

facts.statement: The type species of the genus is Yueosaurus tiantaiensis.
facts.quote: the type species is Yueosaurus tiantaiensis

facts.statement: The generic name Yueosaurus is derived from "Yue", the ancient name for Zhejiang Province.
facts.quote: the generic name is derived from "Yue", the ancient name for Zhejiang

facts.statement: The specific name tiantaiensis refers to the Tiantai locality where the holotype was found.
facts.quote: the specific name refers to the Tiantai, where the holotype was discovered

facts.statement: Fossils of Yueosaurus were collected from the Liangtoutang Formation in the Albian-Cenomanian stages of the Early to Late Cretaceous.
facts.quote: It was collected in Tiantai locality from the Liangtoutang Formation, dating to the Albian-Cenomanian stages of the latest Early Cretaceous and the earliest Late Cretaceous

facts.statement: Researchers suggest that Yueosaurus might be a member of Jeholosauridae or closely related to it.
facts.quote: Han et al. found it plausible that Yueosaurus might be a member of Jeholosauridae or closely related to it

facts.statement: Yueosaurus belongs to the parent group Orodrominae.
Yueosaurus is classified within the family Thescelosauridae.
Yueosaurus is a member of the dinosaur class Ornithischia.
Yueosaurus lived between 113.2 and 93.9 million years ago during the Albian to Cenomanian stages.
facts.quote: Time range: Albian to Cenomanian (113.2 to 93.9 million years ago)
